# GraphicsServiceExtensions

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Graphics` · class

```csharp
public static class GraphicsServiceExtensions
```

Textures from PNG and JPEG images that arrive at run time: one downloaded, or picked by the player. To work with an image's pixels first, decode it with DotGame.Imaging's [`PngCodec`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Imaging/blob/main/docs/api/PngCodec.md), [`JpegCodec`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Imaging/blob/main/docs/api/JpegCodec.md) or [`ImageDecoder`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Imaging/blob/main/docs/api/ImageDecoder.md).

## Methods

### CreateTextureFromJpeg

```csharp
public static Texture CreateTextureFromJpeg(this GraphicsService graphics, ReadOnlySpan<byte> jpeg)
```

Types: [`Texture`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Texture.md), [`GraphicsService`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/GraphicsService.md)

Makes a texture from a JPEG image's bytes. It's yours to dispose. A game that ships the JPEG decoder credits the Independent JPEG Group (see [`JpegCodec`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Imaging/blob/main/docs/api/JpegCodec.md)).

**Throws `InvalidDataException`:** The bytes aren't a JPEG image, or it's damaged.

**Throws `NotSupportedException`:** The image is of a kind the decoder doesn't read (see [`JpegCodec.Decode`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Imaging/blob/main/docs/api/JpegCodec.md#decode)).

### CreateTextureFromPng

```csharp
public static Texture CreateTextureFromPng(this GraphicsService graphics, ReadOnlySpan<byte> png)
```

Types: [`Texture`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Texture.md), [`GraphicsService`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/GraphicsService.md)

Makes a texture from a PNG image's bytes. It's yours to dispose.

**Throws `InvalidDataException`:** The bytes aren't a PNG image, or it's damaged.

**Throws `NotSupportedException`:** The image is of a kind the decoder doesn't read (see [`PngCodec.Decode`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Imaging/blob/main/docs/api/PngCodec.md#decode)).

### CreateTextureFromPngAsync

```csharp
public static async Task<Texture> CreateTextureFromPngAsync(this GraphicsService graphics, Stream stream, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Types: [`Texture`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Texture.md), [`GraphicsService`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/GraphicsService.md)

Reads a PNG image from a stream and makes a texture from it. Reading is asynchronous, and decoding happens on the game thread, so a very large image takes a frame or more.
